home.title: Mizani — Advocates Complaints Commission
home.tagline: File a complaint against an advocate and follow it to resolution.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your mobile number. We will send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
login.codeSent: We sent a code to your phone. It expires in 10 minutes.

errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid Kenyan mobile number, e.g. 0712 345 678.
errors.rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Please wait 10 minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the SMS or request a new code.

myCases.title: My cases
myCases.empty: You have not filed any complaints yet.

file.title: File a complaint
file.intro: Tell us about the advocate and what happened. You will get a case number and a PIN to track your complaint.
file.advocateHint: Start typing to search the roll of advocates. If you cannot find them, type the name as you know it.
file.evidenceHint: Up to 5 files: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB each.
file.consent: I consent to the Advocates Complaints Commission processing my personal data to handle this complaint, under the Data Protection Act, 2019.

errors.invalid_input: Please fix the following and submit again:
errors.too_many_files: You can attach at most 5 files.
errors.file_too_large: Each file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.file_type: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files are accepted.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.server: Something went wrong and your complaint was not filed. Please try again.

fieldErrors.advocateId: Choose the advocate again from the list.
fieldErrors.consentDataProcessing: You must give consent to continue.

success.title: Complaint received
success.body: We have sent these details to your phone by SMS.
success.pinWarning: Keep this PIN private. You need it with your case number to check status by USSD or on the status page.

status.title: Check case status
status.intro: Enter your case number and the PIN you received when you filed. You can also dial the ACC USSD code from any phone.

errors.bad_case_number: Enter the case number as shown on your slip or SMS, e.g. ACC/2026/000123.
errors.invalid: Case number and PIN do not match. Please check and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong attempts for this case. Try again in 1 hour.

staffLogin.title: Staff sign-in
staffLogin.intro: For ACC staff and commissioners. You will also need your authenticator app.

mfa.title: Enter your authenticator code
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Mizani.
mfa.enrolIntro: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:

errors.invalid_code: That code is not correct. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.

staffCase.readOnly: You can view this case. Changes are made by officers and administrators.

errors.stale: This case was changed by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
errors.not_allowed: That stage change is not allowed from the current stage.
errors.reason_required: Give a reason for closing the case.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.invalid: That could not be saved. Check the form and try again.

intake.title: Walk-in intake
intake.intro: File a complaint for someone who has come to the office, written in, or called. They get a slip with their case number and PIN.
intake.phoneHint: Leave empty if they have no phone. With a number, they also get SMS updates and can sign in online.
intake.consent: The complainant consented (verbally or in writing) to the ACC processing their personal data for this complaint, under the Data Protection Act, 2019.

fieldErrors.phone: Enter a valid Kenyan mobile number, or leave it empty.
fieldErrors.phoneConfirm: The two phone numbers do not match. Check with the complainant and type it again.

errors.invalid_input: Please fix the following and submit again:
errors.too_many_files: You can attach at most 5 files.
errors.file_too_large: Each file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.file_type: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files are accepted.
errors.forbidden: Only officers and administrators can register walk-in complaints.
errors.server: Something went wrong and the complaint was not registered. Please try again.

slip.title: Complaint receipt
slip.howToCheck: Check your case status at {url} or by dialling the ACC USSD code, using your case number and PIN.
slip.keepPin: Keep this slip safe. Do not share your PIN.

respond.sent: Thank you. Your answer was sent.

errors.self: You cannot change your own access or role. Ask another administrator.

users.title: Staff accounts
users.intro: Create accounts, change roles, deactivate leavers.
users.name: Name
users.created: Account created. Give this temporary password to the person securely; it will not be shown again:

settings.title: Workflow settings
settings.intro: Time limits, stage names, conciliation and complaint categories.
settings.categoriesHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, e.g. withheld_funds.
settings.aiHint: When off, nothing is sent to any AI provider and staff triage manually. Personal details are always removed before text is sent.

routing.title: Routing rules
routing.intro: Decide which officers receive new cases.
routing.explain: New cases go to the first matching rule (lowest position), to whichever officer in its list has the fewest open cases. Empty fields match anything. If no rule matches, the least-busy officer overall gets the case.
routing.none: No rules yet: cases go to the least-busy officer.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every view, download and change, with who and when.

ai.label: AI-generated suggestion
ai.off: AI is switched off. All work continues as normal.
ai.unavailable: AI suggestion unavailable for this case.
ai.summaryUnavailable: AI summary unavailable. Try again later.
ai.checkOriginal: Check against the original complaint before applying. Personal details were removed before the AI saw it.
